extracted.name: Slow Cooker Leg of Lamb
extracted.description: This slow cooker leg of lamb recipe coats the leg in lemon zest, garlic, and fresh herbs, is easy to prepare in the slow cooker, and is ready in 6 hours.
instruction_lines: Grate lemon zest into a mortar; reserve zested lemon. Add garlic, rosemary, thyme, parsley, olive oil, sea salt, black pepper, and onion powder to the mortar; grind into a paste using a pestle.
Pat lamb dry; rub herb mixture all over lamb. Place into a 3-quart slow cooker; squeeze juice of reserved lemon over lamb. Add broth and cover slow cooker.
Cook on Low for 6 to 8 hours.
